verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a broad first-party voice library (5k+ voices across 31/70+ languages) with voice customization (speed, pronunciation, multi-voice switching), but the evidence pack shows no mention of plugging in external/third-party TTS providers—only ElevenLabs' own voices are referenced. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-provider TTS support (e.g., bring-your-own-TTS integration), independent hands-on confirmation of voice library breadth/quality.
